  Scenario: AC15 A sample with no labelled rows for the agent is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the labelled sample for agent "EXTRACT" holds no labelled rows
    When RW-COE starts the evaluation of "EXTRACT" on that sample
    Then the request is refused with 422 and MSG-P10-002
    Then no evaluation run row and no score row exist

  Scenario: AC16 A fake for a consumed service is refused by the preflight (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a fake is configured for one of P5, P10, P3 or P4
    When SuiteRunner runs the preflight
    Then the run is refused before any assertion
    Then only the INT-23 stub and the W1J01 synthetic document fixture are stubbed

  Scenario: AC17 Policy values are read through contracts and every call is one hop (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the suite runs against the SIT endpoints of P5, P10, P3 and P4
    When the evaluation of "EXTRACT" on "EXTRACT-S1" version 1 runs
    Then the target precision, sample floor, tie order and approach names are read through the P10 or P3 contract at run time and written in no suite code (BR12)
    Then every REST call of the run is one hop to its owning service with a 2 s client budget (BR15)
    Then the suite holds no schema client and a pipeline scan fails any change that adds a database connection (BR16)
